reference_accuracy_sources: Existing 021 primary scored ledger (25 queries) plus independently input-matched old official revision supplement (2 queries). No new gold download.
FillMissing: Route any task with at least one query having fewer than two real unique 4B candidates. If a different real 27B prediction is available, add it beside an existing first real 4B candidate; if 4B has none, use 27B in both slots. Otherwise retain the original 4B slots.
ReplaceSecond: Use the same rule for every query: preserve 4B attempt_1; insert a different real 27B grid in attempt_2. If no real 27B grid or it equals 4B attempt_1, retain both original 4B slots. Logical 27B call requirement is all20 tasks.
thresholds: None. No gold-driven task ID filter, confidence threshold, or answer selection.
oracle_metrics: ScoredCandidateOracle covers only the supplied rescored/ranked pool. Optional RawCandidateOracle separately covers supplied original legal inverse-transformed DFS grids, with raw-correct absent from scored export/not-selected diagnostics. Neither oracle nor its union with27B chooses policy slots. Missing raw evidence remains unconfirmed and cannot justify training conclusions.
cost_scope: Reuse existing full E20 artifacts; no new inference or B1 arm. Record actual completed 4B cost when supplied, existing 27B full E20 driver cost, and prior observed token/request costs for logical routed tasks. Deployment within12h remains unverified.
